title: Accessible public interfaces
body: Public pages must provide a descriptive document title, keyboard-accessible controls, and meaningful labels for user inputs.

title: Data collection notice
body: Pages that collect personal information must identify the purpose of collection and link to the current privacy notice before submission.

title: Transport protection
body: Public application pages and forms must be delivered over HTTPS. Passwords, tokens, and personal data must never be exposed in page text or URLs.
